title: Payload — identity.device_authorized
$comment: Signed by the root identity key. `label` is optional and worth a warning in the client: device names leak more than people expect, and the event is permanent. additionalProperties is true by design: the versioning rules require that a new optional field survives a node that cannot interpret it, preserved byte-exactly for the digest. Every envelope field name is forbidden here (set to false): the convention that a payload never duplicates the envelope is enforced by the schema, not left to prose.
